nodes.n: 11:40 PM. Video call. Aryan is in his bedroom in Delhi, a crutch leaning on the wall, a grey hoodie, no gel in his hair. He looks five years younger and ten years older.

nodes.t: I gave Diya's source the minutes. Both times. I photographed them off my uncle's laptop the night after you found me in the physio room.
I kept thinking about what you said. That I'd tear it right through. You were the only person who said something true to me that whole tour.
Now they're going to destroy her for something I did. And my uncle is my uncle. He pays my mother's hospital bills.

choice.t: "Tell Rekha Iyer. I'll be standing next to you."
"You owe Diya the truth. Not me."

choice.d: Take it out of his hands.

nodes.t: ...Okay. Give me two days. I have to tell my mother first.
Then do it. I'd do the same. That's the problem with us. We'd both do the same.

nodes.n: You hang up at 12:20. At 12:24, your phone lights up with a weather alert for Alappuzha. Red. Then another. Then Shibu.
Kuttanad. The monsoon has come back two weeks late and very angry. The river is over the bank. Lightning turns the whole sky purple.

nodes.t: Amma's safe! Amma is safe! She's at the church hall with everyone. Listen to me. Amma is safe.
The Lakshmi isn't. The mooring broke. She's on her side by the jetty. Half the roof is in the river.

nodes.n: He turns the phone. In the lightning, you see her. Your father's houseboat, the one Amma kept afloat for twenty years, tilted in the water like a tired animal.

nodes.t: Don't look at it. Look at me. I'm fine. A boat is wood and rope. We have more wood. We have more rope.
You have a match in three days. Don't you dare get on a plane.

choice.t: "Okay. I'll stay. But I'm sending my match fee. All of it."

nodes.t: Keep half. Buy proper food. Not bananas.
{first}. Listen to your mother. If you come home, I will put you back on the plane myself.

nodes.cliff: The Lakshmi is half under water. Amma says stay. Every part of you says go.
